ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in parallelogram $ABCD$, $E$ is a point on $CD$. $DE:CE=2:3$. Connect $AE$ and $BD$ which intersect at point $F$. What is the value of $\frac{S_{\triangle DEF}}{S_{\triangle ABF}}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} In parallelogram $ABCD$, we have $DC=AB$ and $DC\parallel AB$,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle DEF\sim \triangle BAF$,\\
$\because$ $DE\colon CE=2\colon 3$,\\
$\therefore$ $DE\colon DC=2\colon 5$,\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{DE}{AB}=\frac{2}{5}$,\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{S_{\triangle DEF}}{S_{\triangle ABF}}=\left(\frac{2}{5}\right)^2=\boxed{\frac{4}{25}}$;

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a parallelogram ABCD, with A and B on the lower side, and D and C on the upper side; point E is located on the upper side DC, therefore D, E, and C are collinear, and DE is a part of DC. In the figure, AE and DB are connected, and they intersect at point F inside the parallelogram. From the graphical structure of the parallelogram, it can be seen that the upper side DC is parallel to the lower side AB, so DE is also parallel to AB. Reasoning: It is known that DE:CE = 2:3, so DE:DC = 2:(2+3) = 2:5. In a parallelogram, opposite sides are equal, therefore DC = AB, so DE:AB = 2:5. Also because F is on DB, F is on AE, and DE ∥ AB, ∠DEF and ∠BAF are correspondingly equal, and ∠DFE and ∠BFA are equal as vertical angles, therefore △DEF ∼ △BAF. The ratio of the areas of similar triangles is equal to the square of the ratio of the corresponding side lengths, so S△DEF / S△ABF = (DE/AB)^2 = (2/5)^2 = 4/25.
